summary: Validated the CelebrationDialog bug fix end-to-end via Playwright as MASTER (Vinicius session cookie). Three sale creations through the Dashboard 'Nova venda' flow + inspection of the celebration modal and PNG generation.

action_items: (Optional cleanup) The test created 3 TEST sales in GOLDEN VILLE GUAIUBA for 2026-10-19: broker Aninha (Qd 210/Lt 619, client TEST Cliente 2885), broker aninha (Qd 610/Lt 526, TEST Cliente 3493), broker Carlão (Qd 544/Lt 762, TEST Cliente 6465). Main agent can clean up if desired.

critical_code_review_comments: CelebrationDialog.loadImageSafe uses `credentials: 'include'` fetch for arbitrary src; harmless here since photo URLs end up as data: URLs served inline from backend, but for cross-origin remote images this could still taint if the server lacks CORS. Current flow is safe because the picture field is a data URL in Mongo.
The sale-form 'Valor da venda' CurrencyInput appears to parse typed digits non-trivially (typing '150000' resulted in R$ 1.500,00). Not in scope, but worth confirming expected UX.
seed_data_creation: 3 test sales created in Dashboard (see action_items for details).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for CelebrationDialog photo (norm() case/accent-insensitive matching + loadImageSafe via blob + toBlob try/catch) is confirmed working. The avatar inside [data-testid=celebration-dialog] shows an with data: URL when the matched corretor has a picture, and canvas.toBlob succeeds (no 'Não foi possível gerar a imagem.' toast) in all tested scenarios including the fallback-initials case for Carlão.
